van-gogh.selection_note: Visible directional paint, strong color relationships and substantial differences in subject and composition.

seurat-pointillism.selection_note: La Grande Jatte supplies divided-color marks. The earlier Bathers study is looser and remains calibration-only, not a pointillist target.

manet.selection_note: Broad visible brushwork and value masses across a still life and an outdoor scene.
